messages:
alyssa: Ok team — proposing a DB cutover tonight for the users.addresses rename. Target window 22:00 UTC. No full outage expected, but we need dual-write + backfill coordination. Who can own the deploy?

mike: I can take the deploy and canary traffic shift if @raj can cover rollback validation. :+1:

raj: I can be on rollback. Quick question — how long do we expect the backfill to run for 30-day window?

alyssa: Estimated ~2.5-3h for the full backfill if it runs after canary. But we only need a short warmbackfill (30m) before switching reads; full backfill async overnight. Dual-write window = 20m to allow live-sync + KV cache warmup.

marina: Smoke checklist (short):
- healthcheck on /health and /v1/users/:id -> new_address present when writing to both columns
- sample reads from replica lag < 10s
- no 5xx spikes in last 10m

marina: Quick smoke commands to run after deploy:
```bash
# write -> read verification
http POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/users/123 address='{\"line1\":\"test\"}' | jq .
http GET https://api.redwood.internal/v1/users/123 | jq .address
# check replica lag
kubectl -n db exec -it replica-0 -- psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag;"
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment 2024-10-05T22:00:00Z by @mike — job id 5891 — canary 10% for 5m then 50% for 10m then 100%

mike: Will kick at 22:00. Rolling canary as above. If canary errors >2% in 5m we abort and rollback.

sre-oncall: I will watch infra metrics and have DB failback checklist ready. Confirming we have a tested migration rollback script?

alyssa: Rollback plan:
- toggle feature flag to stop writing to new column (instant)
- run deploy to revert app schema-change code (if needed)
- run `pg_cancel_backend` if we need to pause long-running backfill jobs
- final db revert is manual and reserved for post-mortem (shouldn't be needed)
Commit hash for deploy: fa1b2c3.

raj: I ran the rollback script in staging yesterday — works but requires sudo on migration runner. I'll have that access at 21:50.

mike: Prechecks I'll run at 21:30:
- ensure replica lag < 5s
- smoke run against staging config in prod-mode
- confirm key rotations and connection pool sizes

alyssa: Permissions: @raj and @mike have DB runner access, @marina has smoke test access. I'll post the final go/no-go at 21:55 UTC. If anything slips, we move to backup window at 02:00 UTC.

marina: I can automate a quick smoke script and post results to this thread at 22:06.

mike: Noted. I'll also leave a verbose deploy comment and link to the dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/deploys/5891

alyssa: Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: when you're set.

mike: :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
marina: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :thumbsup:
